articles.summary: New research finds that AI’s influence changes throughout the purchase journey, playing a larger role in the mid-funnel research and evaluation stage (44%) than in discovery (33%) or decision-making (20%). Six in 10 buying groups
articles.title: New Report from Informa TechTarget Identifies Key Shifts in B2B Technology Purchase Journeys Driven by AI, Buying Groups, and Evolving Media Habits
